acceptance: Red first: a lane diff that adds a package without regenerating go/.darwin-set fails the build floor with a correction that names `evolve ci darwin-set generate`.
Red first: a lane diff with an errcheck finding fails the floor and names the file and line.
Docs: the derived and core package notes change in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: At the build floor (so the builder can correct it) run golangci-lint on the changed packages and the check verb of every internal/derived entry whose inputs the diff touches; at ship, refuse a tree whose derived files are stale. One list: the derived registry drives both.
summary: 2026-11-14: main went red at ba124fd27 (wave 171). A lane cycle added go/cmd/testlatency with an unchecked f.Close (golangci-lint errcheck) and without regenerating go/.darwin-set; required CI failed on golangci-lint, TestDarwinSetFile_MatchesTheSetDerivedFromTheTree and TestPRRefresh_TheRealGeneratorsOfACloneCommitOnlyTheStaleIndex. The main-red stop then parked every lane until the console fix (PR 1447). The lane floors and the ship gates run neither golangci-lint on the changed packages nor the derived-file checks of internal/derived (flags, signal codes, research index, darwin set). Plan context: docs/architecture/packages/internal-derived.md; docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md (main protection).
title: A lane cannot ship a golangci-lint finding or a stale derived file
